witness.text: Experienced Backend Engineer with expertise in Go services for payment processing systems, including authorisation retries, reversals, and settlement batch operations.

repairLog.detail: Experienced Backend Engineer with expertise in Go services for payment processing systems, including authorisation retri

experienceHighlights.text: Developed and maintained a Go retry service for soft-declined card authorisations, implementing idempotency keys in PostgreSQL to prevent duplicate charges.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote a Go retry service for soft-declined card authorisations at Kestrel Merchant Services, storing idempotency keys in PostgreSQL so that a retried request could never be charged twice.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the reversal API for voiding authorisations, adding contract tests against a card-scheme simulator before releases.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the reversal API that voids an authorisation when a merchant cancels an order, adding contract tests against the card-scheme simulator before each release.

experienceHighlights.text: Served on the settlement batch on-call rota from October 2022 to January 2024, working incidents through runbooks and filing post-incident reviews for two batch overruns.
experienceHighlights.witness: Served on the settlement batch on-call rota from October 2022 to January 2024, working incidents through the team's runbooks and filing post-incident reviews for two batch overruns.

experienceHighlights.text: Migrated three ledger tables to a partitioned schema, raising each change request for approval by the change-advisory board before weekend windows.
experienceHighlights.witness: Moved three ledger tables to a partitioned schema, raising each migration as a change request that the change-advisory board approved ahead of the weekend window.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed pull requests for the authorisation gateway team and authored a guide to structured logging for payment events.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed pull requests for the authorisation gateway team and wrote the team's guide to structured logging for payment events.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Authored an eleven-page design document for the soft-decline retry service, covering retry schedules, idempotency-key lifecycle, timeout behaviour, and rollback plans, without payment statistics.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the eleven-page design document for the soft-decline retry service, covering the retry schedule, the idempotency-key lifecycle, behaviour when the card scheme times out and the rollback plan. It describes the design only and includes no payment statistics.

skills.text: Proficient in Go, PostgreSQL, and payment system design with experience in idempotency, failure modes, and rollback planning.
skills.witness: Wrote a Go retry service for soft-declined card authorisations at Kestrel Merchant Services, storing idempotency keys in PostgreSQL so that a retried request could never be charged twice.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on Go services, design documents, on-call rota, schema changes, and contract testing. They do not establish a measured reduction in failed payments or the candidate's personal role in approval of schema changes.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess the candidate's role in approval of schema changes and to verify the claimed 40% reduction in failed payments.
